title: Orthotopic lung epithelial cell transplantation
protocol: Administer 280 FFU of Influenza A/H1N1/Puerto Rico/8/34 (PR8) intra-nasally to recipient mice.
Dissolve PR8 virus in 30 μl of PBS.
Pipette the dissolved PR8 virus onto the nostrils of heavily anesthetized mice.
Confirm proper anesthesia by visual confirmation of agonal breathing.
Ensure properly anesthetized mice aspirate the fluid directly into their lungs.
Isolate donor cells from a ubiquitously fluorophore-expressing mouse at 9 days post-infection.
Resuspend isolated donor cells in 50 μl sterile PBS after sorting.
Transplant cell solution intranasally into recipient mice.
Keep mice in a nose cone with a flow of 100% oxygen to aid recovery and decrease accidental death risk.
Observe engraftment using between 1,000 to 1 million donor cells.
Anesthetize mice at day 21 post-infection for tissue harvest.
Perfuse and lavage lungs three times with 1 ml PBS.
Inflate lungs with about 0.75 mls of 4% PFA and tie off at the trachea.
Rock inflated lungs in an additional 20 ml of 4% PFA for 1 hour.
Decant PFA solution from lungs, rinse with PBS, and decant again.
Replace with fresh PBS and rock incubate lungs for 1-4 hours at room temperature.
Incubate lungs overnight in 30% sucrose in PBS + 0.02% azide on a rocker at 4 degrees Celsius.
Decant sucrose solution the next day and replace with 50% OCT / 15% sucrose / PBS for 2 hours at room temperature.
Dissect each lung lobe and trachea carefully.
Arrange dissected lungs and trachea in a cryomold containing 100% OCT.
Incubate the cryomold on ice for 1 hour.
Freeze the entire cryomold in a dry ice alcohol bath.
